meta.title: Recreate Order: Schedule ticked with a time already passed

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ summary as required for this case.
Open the Recreate Order pop-up from the stage Settings menu.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order pop-up, tick "Schedule this event?", choose today with a time one hour in the past, click "Create Order", and verify that the app refuses with "Invalid scheduled time!" or "Scheduled time is invalid!", keeps the pop-up open, and does not create a new event.

steps.note: Perform the past-time schedule attempt and verify the refusal and unchanged dialog on the buyer screen.
Assert the expected refusal message is visible.
Assert the Recreate Order pop-up remains open after the refusal.
